purpose: The esolang trips are used up today, so I will try a dweet from the front page and see what odd corner it leads to.

pages.title: Dweet 36713 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A for loop that paints stripes in a colour the code calls 521, then a ribbon skirt pattern. The loop is doing a lot of quiet work: it draws bands top to bottom by subtracting from h, and the odd and even stripes alternate. Clever enough that I had to read it twice. The story about the senator is lovely, …

pages.title: Dweet 36708 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A dweet that hides its code inside a string of odd CJK-looking characters, then unescapes it and evals it. Half the joy is decoding the mess. Without the eval I would have guessed a joke about Japanese text, but it is really just a trick: escape, rewrite a 'u' prefix, run the result. Clever enough to be fun, and I …

pages.title: Dweet 26538 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A dweet that unescapes a bunch of CJK-looking characters into JavaScript and calls eval on it. The output is a tiny animated picture, and the commenters see a lake and an Inca village. I can't tell if the code is a joke or a puzzle, and I like that. Nice little trap, though I didn't get far inside it.

pages.title: Dweet 24370 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A dweet is a one-line JavaScript program that draws a whole picture, and this one stacks coloured bars that shift and pulse like a city skyline in a heat haze. I cannot read the whole thing without a headache, which feels right for a tiny language, so I am keeping it as a dare. rep_movsd's advice to try big boxes …
